notes.title: Update 2.7.0
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606564/0994601a0e68bf4382c7afc09590e3b22eb66da2.png"]🟢 Total:

– fixed a bug with a Snake–Gorynych;

– two divisions in Frontier mode, with high online levels, divisions do not transfer players between divisions so that novices leave with novices, and experienced ones with experienced ones;

– in ARAM mode, with low online, instead of 5x5, there will be 3x3;

– in ARAM mode, a vestibule has appeared, where there is an algorithm of random heroes available for the player to choose.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606564/b4934cd586deb69be68c5810b1a602aede79532a.png"]

🟢 The launcher:

– the mini-map in the vestibule has been updated, the position on the map will be displayed according to the side of your team - the Docts or the Adornians;

– if the player has chosen a hero where there is no build or wants to change, then a "random build" from the hall of fame for this hero is now available right in the vestibule.;

– Updated player stats in the castle: Now by entering your nickname in the search, you can see detailed information about yourself, and you can also view information about any player on the server.;

– there will be internal game achievements in the new statistics;

– the queue display has been moved by modes in the castle, as well as the display of your division (upper right corner);

– each "queue" of a certain mode has its own Hall of Fame, according to this mode ("medals"), it will be available in a few days;

– fixed the exit after the "theft of builds" from the hall of fame, now the transfer goes directly to the build in the castle, and not the old version of the launcher.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606564/b4934cd586deb69be68c5810b1a602aede79532a.png"]

notes.title: New ARAM Mode Rules
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606564/a15dbf511248c64b60f3376057d04a7a857d41e3.jpg"]👉 New ARAM rules:
—  there are 15 random heroes available in the vestibule, have time to pick up the best among them to make your team's peak stronger than the enemy's;
— you can use your builds or generate a random build from the Hall of Fame for any hero right in the vestibule.

‼️  The ARAM victory rating has been temporarily increased by 25% compared to the Borderlands.

ARAM — is a dynamic 5x5 battle on a single line without a forest and with fast leveling of heroes. In ARAM, you cannot restore the hero's health at the main base.

notes.title: Minor changes
notes.content:
1. closing the window after authorization via steam
2. automatic change of language in the lock depending on the localization of the OS system (check required)
3. displaying players in queues for all modes in the drop-down list of modes.

notes.title: Updating network connections
notes.content:
* The game client has been reassigned to a different port (in the range of Steam ports). Connections for players who previously used RadminVPN to connect are expected to be fixed (you will need to uncheck the box in the menu)
* Another domain name with a neutral name has been added. Connection errors for players who continue to use VPN services are expected to be fixed.
* The mechanism for connecting players when entering the castle has been improved. Now the first available server will be selected as the starting connection server. This will improve the responsiveness of the castle for all players

notes.title: Visual edits
notes.content: Removed visual displays of errors that are not necessary to avoid confusing players
